```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(kableExtra)
trades <- read.csv('data/trades.csv')
claims <- read.csv('data/claims.csv')
draft26 <- read.csv('data/draft26.csv')
draft25 <- read.csv('data/draft25.csv')
draft24 <- read.csv('data/draft24.csv')
draft23 <- read.csv('data/draft23.csv')
draft22 <- read.csv('data/draft22.csv')
```

# RJML Transactions {.tabset .tabset-pills}

## Trades

```{r}
trades |> 
      kbl(caption = "Recent RJML Trades",
          align='ccllll',
          col.names = c('Year','No.','Team A','A Receives','Team B', 'B Receives')) |> 
      kable_styling(font_size = 16,full_width = F,fixed_thead = T,bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")) |>
      column_spec(c(3,5),color = 'steelblue', border_left = TRUE) |> 
  scroll_box(height = "500px")
```

## FA  Claims

```{r}
claims |> kbl(caption = "RJML 2026 FA Claims",
              align='clllc',
              col.names = c('No.','Team','Added','Dropped','Window')) |> 
      kable_styling(font_size = 16,full_width = F,fixed_thead = T,bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive"))  |> 
  scroll_box(height = "500px")
```


## Recent Drafts {.tabset .tabset-pills}
```{r,echo=F}
early_rounds <- paste('Round',1:6)
late_rounds <- paste('Round',7:13)
```

### 2026 {.tabset .tabset-pills}

#### Rounds 1-6

```{r}
draft26[,1:7] |> 
  kbl(col.names = c("Pick",early_rounds)) |> 
  kable_paper(full_width = F,fixed_thead = T) |> 
  scroll_box(height = "500px",width="100%")
```

#### Rounds 7-13

```{r}
draft26[,c(1,8:14)] |> 
  kbl(col.names = c("Pick",late_rounds)) |> 
  kable_paper(full_width = F,fixed_thead = T) |> 
  scroll_box(height = "500px",width="100%")
```
